title: WB-FF-DS registry: an agent manifest
description: What one agent may do and how its work is checked. Its Claude Code agent file is generated from this manifest; hooks and CI enforce it.

name.description: The Claude Code agent name. Hooks receive it as agent_type. "unregistered" is reserved for the run log.

role.description: foundation: owns one foundation's rules and sources. reviewer: reviews other agents' work against the rules tagged for it.

foundation.description: The foundation folder a foundation agent owns. Foundation agents only.

consumer.description: The consumer tag whose rules a reviewer loads, e.g. a11y. Reviewers only.

description.description: When to hand work to this agent. Becomes the agent file's description.

tools.description: The tools the agent may use. Bash is not offered (DEC-040); the web tools only read (DEC-041).

writeScope.description: Paths the agent may write, relative to the repository: a file, or a folder ending in /**. Every other write is refused. No segment may start with a dot, so .claude, .github and .. can't be named.

gate.description: What runs when the agent tries to finish.

checks.description: npm scripts to run. Each must exist in package.json.

maxRetries.description: How many times the agent may fix and retry after a failed check before it must stop as blocked.

reviewedBy.description: Reviewer agents that check this agent's work.

model.description: The model alias for the agent file. Omit it to inherit the session's model.

effort.description: The effort level for the agent file. Omit it to inherit the session's level.

outcome.description: passed: every gate check passed. blocked: a check still fails after the allowed retries. needs-decision: the work waits on a decision only a person can make. cancelled: stopped before finishing.
